usagePolicy.undatedAllTimeDecadeAllStarPortraits: retain as supplemental assets; do not invent an exact year without evidence
usagePolicy.recommendedSelection: For a historical season, select a dated historical portrait anchored to that era. At the current/native season, prefer the game's own current portrait when present.

htmlTransport: same-origin browser iframe navigation; no fetch/XHR for HTML pages

currentNativePrecedence.rule: If the game already has a native/current portrait, use it instead of the 2KRatings current portrait.
currentNativePrecedence.twoKRatingsCurrentPurpose: retained supplemental/fallback asset; never forced over native current portrait
currentNativePrecedence.historicalPurpose: dated era/headshot source so the player's appearance can change across historical years

profiles.reason: Roster pages already expose portraits; automatic Other Versions/profile expansion caused the previous runaway crawl.

exclusions.note: This pass is NBA portrait history/supplemental assets only.
